title: Head-to-head W/L/D is derivable but not demonstrated by a test
evidence: views.sql:7 team_results exposes win/draw/loss + opponent columns, so SELECT sum(win),sum(draw),sum(loss) FROM team_results WHERE team=? AND opponent=? works; but tests.rs:26 only counts meetings (count(*)), never asserts a W/L/D head-to-head aggregate
suggestion: Add a scenario asserting win/draw/loss totals between two named teams to lock the h2h capability

title: Single generic query_soccer(sql) tool instead of per-category MCP tools
evidence: main.rs:76-91 exposes one tool taking raw SQL; all five query categories are pushed into SQL rather than discrete handlers
suggestion: Design is valid and well-sandboxed (main.rs:16-27 authorizer + stmt.readonly() check at main.rs:32); noted only as a deviation from the spec's per-category framing for cross-run comparison

title: BR-Football-Dataset competition taken verbatim from the raw 'tournament' column
evidence: data.rs:143 `_ => get("tournament")` stores competition names outside the three required (Serie A/Copa do Brasil/Libertadores) unnormalized, e.g. Serie B/C mentioned in main.rs:15 DESCRIPTION
suggestion: Acceptable — the three required competitions are covered; raw tournament strings add coverage but are not canonicalized

title: Match reconciliation deduplicates overlapping fixtures across 5 CSVs into one matches table
evidence: data.rs:158-193 merges rows by competition+teams+date/season (and ±1 day for the season-less extended file), coalescing scores; records table preserves provenance
suggestion: Beyond spec — a cleaner data model than required; no action needed
